body:
This record sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin. It covers Room-Temperature, Ambient-Pressure Superconducting Devices — Practical electronic systems based on superconductors that work under ordinary environmental conditions, if such materials become available.

Materials are the quiet foundation of every other technology on this list. Computational discovery now proposes candidates faster than labs can test them; metamaterials engineer properties from geometry; self-healing and shape-changing materials add function. Atomically precise manufacturing works at the single-atom level and fails at the kilogram level — that gap is the whole field. Honest state: steady compounding wins, occasional genuine surprises (like high-pressure hydride superconductors), and a long road from record property to affordable product.

Feasibility tier: UNRESOLVED. It is not currently known whether this is possible at all: the science is incomplete, the barriers may be fundamental, and honest experts disagree. Records at this tier map the unknowns rather than asserting outcomes, and treat "we do not know" as a result.
